scripts.db:migrate:deploy: dotenv -e .env.example -- sh -c 'DATABASE_URL=${MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL} prisma migrate deploy --schema database/prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env.example -- concurrently -n api,bot,dashboard -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @blackcat/api" "npm run dev -w @blackcat/bot" "npm run dev -w @blackcat/dashboard"
